name: dsu empty
why: n=0 has no vertices, so there are no operations and no states.

name: dsu self and repeated unions
why: Union of a vertex with itself never changes the partition: 1 component of size 1 after each operation.

name: dsu README example
why: Published example.

name: kruskal empty
why: n=0: empty forest, 0 components.

name: prim isolates only
why: 3 isolated vertices are 3 components; no edges can be chosen.

name: kruskal loops parallel negative
why: Self-loop id0 (-100) must be ignored. Cheapest 0-1 is id2 (-2); then 1-2 costs 7 (id3 or id4). Cost -2+7=5, one component.

name: prim loops parallel negative
why: Same graph as above; Prim must reach the same optimum cost 5. Alternative id4 instead of id3 is also valid.

name: kruskal 64-bit total
why: A path needs all three edges: 3*10^9 = 3000000000 > 2^31-1.

name: prim restart in every component
why: Components {0,1,2}, {3,4}, {5}. Best triangle tree uses 1 (id1) + 2 (id2); {3,4} uses -5. Cost -2, 3 components, 6-3=3 edges.

name: kruskal equal weights
why: 4-cycle with all weights 1: any 3 edges form a tree, cost 3.

name: scc empty
why: n=0: both arrays empty.

name: scc isolates
why: 3 isolated vertices are 3 separate SCCs, no cross pairs.

name: scc self-loop and duplicates
why: 0 has only a self-loop: own SCC. 1<->2 form one SCC. Duplicate 0->1 gives ONE cross pair.

name: scc chain of cycles
why: {0,1,2} cycle -> {3,4} cycle -> {5}. Condensation A->B, B->C only.

name: topo empty
why: n=0 is acyclic with empty order.

name: topo isolates
why: No edges: any permutation is valid.

name: topo self-loop
why: 1->1 is a directed cycle.

name: topo cycle in another component
why: 2->3->4->2 is a cycle not reachable from 0; whole graph is cyclic.

name: topo diamond with duplicate
why: 0 before 1,2; 1,2 before 3. Finished vertex 3 reached twice is not a cycle.

name: dag singleton
why: Only the source: distance 0, parent -1.

name: dag unreachable and distance -1
why: 0->1 weight -1 gives a REAL distance -1. Vertices 2,3 are unreachable from 0: null and -1 parent; edge 2->3 must not be relaxed.

name: dag cycle unreachable from source
why: 2<->3 cycle cannot be reached from 0, but the whole graph is still cyclic.

name: dag tied and parallel edges
why: Two parallel 0->1 edges (id0,id1) both cost 2. Vertex 3: via 1 = 2+1 = 3, via 2 = 1+2 = 3 (tie). Distances [0,2,1,3]; several parent arrays are valid.

name: dag negative 64-bit, source not 0
why: Source 1. 1->2 = -1e9, 2->3 = -1e9 gives -2e9 < 1->3 = 5. Vertex 0 is unreachable (edge 0->1 points INTO the source).

name: dag README example
why: Published example: 0->1 (3), 1->2 (-7) gives -4 < 8; 2->3 (4) gives 0; 4 unreachable.
